defender-strange.where: His home universe, Earth-617; dies in the space between universes in the opening scene, and his corpse ends up on Earth-616 (the main MCU world).
defender-strange.source: MCU Wiki 'Earth-617': "'''Earth-617'''{{Ref|DSitMoMAC}} is an alternate universe where Doctor Strange inherited blue magic" (source: the film's audio commentary). Marvel DB 'Earth-TRN953' (Aliases = Earth-617): "Director Sam Raimi identified the reality of Defender Strange as Earth-617 on the audio commentary". Caveat: the number comes from the director's commentary, not the film itself. Marvel DB files him as Stephen Strange (Earth-TRN953) because comics Earth-617 already exists.

sinister-strange.where: His own universe, destroyed by an incursion he caused; he is killed there at the Sinister Sanctum.
sinister-strange.source: Marvel DB 'Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness': "[[Stephen Strange (Earth-TRN954)|Sinister Strange (Stephen Strange)]]" (TRN = the wiki's own temporary number, which its TRN policy calls "wholly unofficial"). MCU Wiki 'Sinister Strange': {{AltUniverse|the "[[Variant Killer Strange Universe]]"}} (a name the wiki made up).

binary.where: An unnamed parallel universe with X-Men, shown in The Marvels mid-credits scene where Monica Rambeau wakes up.
binary.source: Marvel DB 'The Marvels (film)': "{{1st|[[Maria Rambeau (Earth-TRN1225)|Binary (Maria Rambeau)]]}}" (unofficial TRN). MCU Wiki 'Binary': {{AltUniverse|the "[[X-Men Ally Binary Universe]]"}} (a name the wiki made up). This is not Earth-838: Earth-838's Maria Rambeau is the Captain Marvel from Multiverse of Madness.

beast.where: The same unnamed X-Men universe as Binary (The Marvels mid-credits scene).
beast.source: Marvel DB 'The Marvels (film)': "** {{1st|[[Henry McCoy (Earth-TRN1225)|Beast (Dr. Hank McCoy)]]}}" (unofficial TRN). MCU Wiki 'Beast': {{AltUniverse|the "[[X-Men Ally Binary Universe]]"}}

wolverine.where: Taken from his own unnumbered universe, where the X-Men died, to the Void, then to Earth-10005 (Deadpool's world), where he stays.
wolverine.source: Marvel DB 'Earth-TRN1400' (Title = Home to "The Worst Wolverine"): "Logan never returned to his home universe and instead elected to stay in Deadpool's universe once they had finished their mission." MCU Wiki 'Wolverine': {{AltUniverse|the "[[Mutant Genocide Universe]]"}}; "eventually allowing Logan to ... live peacefully in Wade Wilson's universe." His home universe has no official number. Earth-10005 is the Fox Logan's world, not his.

ladypool.where: Pruned to the Void, where she leads the Deadpool Corps for Cassandra Nova; she goes to Earth-10005 for the final fight.
ladypool.source: MCU Wiki 'Ladypool': "Eventually, Ladypool was pruned, causing her to be sent to the [[Void (End of Time)|Void]]. There, she started working for [[Cassandra Nova]] and became the leader of the [[Deadpool Corps]]". Marvel DB files her as Wanda Wilson (Earth-TRN872); TRN872 = "Reality of those Pruned by TVA and sent to the Void". Her home universe has only a wiki-made name: "Corps Leader Deadpool Universe".

nicepool.where: Pruned to the Void with Dogpool; killed on Earth-10005 during the final fight.
nicepool.source: MCU Wiki 'Nicepool': "banished to the [[Void (End of Time)|Void]] by the [[Time Variance Authority]]"; "Nicepool later accompanied the Deadpool Corps to [[Earth-10005]]". Marvel DB: "[[Wade Wilson (Nicepool) (Earth-TRN872)|Nicepool (Wade Wilson)]]" (TRN872 = the Void group). Home universe has only a wiki-made name: "Non-Regenerative Deadpool Universe".

dogpool.where: Pruned to the Void with Nicepool; afterwards lives on Earth-10005 with Deadpool.
dogpool.source: MCU Wiki 'Dogpool': "Mary Puppins, nicknamed Dogpool, is a Pugese-breed dog who was banished to the [[Void (End of Time)|Void]] by the [[Time Variance Authority]] along with her owner, [[Nicepool]]... she stayed in that universe [Earth-10005] to live with Deadpool and his friends." Marvel DB: "[[Mary Puppins (Earth-TRN872)|Dogpool (Mary Puppins)]]".

cassandra-nova.where: Rules the Void; dies on Earth-10005 in the climax. Her birth universe is not identified (not Earth-10005).
cassandra-nova.source: MCU Wiki 'Cassandra Nova': "Nova's reign over the Void..."; "Nova was satisfied with the Void as her home"; {{AltUniverse|the "[[Cassandra Nova Birthed Universe]]"}} (a name the wiki made up). Marvel DB 'Earth-TRN872': "[[Charles Xavier (Earth-TRN872)|Charles Xavier]], who was the twin brother of [[Cassandra Nova Xavier (Earth-TRN872)|Cassandra Nova]]".

kid-loki.where: Pruned to the Void, where he rules a crew of Lokis (Loki S1E5).
kid-loki.source: MCU Wiki 'Kid Loki': "pruned his timeline and exiled him to the [[Void (End of Time)|Void]], where he became a ruler". Original universe: Marvel DB Earth-TRN867 ("Loki killed Thor when they were children", unofficial TRN); MCU Wiki "Kid Thor Killed Universe".

classic-loki.where: Pruned to the Void and joins Kid Loki's crew; dies there holding off Alioth (Loki S1E5).
classic-loki.source: MCU Wiki 'Classic Loki': "pruned by the [[Time Variance Authority]] and sent to the [[Void (End of Time)|Void]], where he joined [[Kid Loki's Crew]]". Original universe: Marvel DB Earth-TRN868 ("Loki cheated death at the hands of Thanos", unofficial TRN); MCU Wiki "Statesman Survivor Loki Universe".

alligator-loki.where: Pruned to the Void and part of Kid Loki's crew (Loki S1E5).
alligator-loki.source: MCU Wiki 'Alligator Loki': "pruned by the [[Time Variance Authority]] for eating a neighbor's [[cat]] and banished to the [[Void (End of Time)|Void]]". Original universe: Marvel DB Earth-TRN869 ("Loki was an Alligator", unofficial TRN).

president-loki.where: Commands an army of Lokis in the Void (Loki S1E5); his original universe is not identified.
president-loki.source: MCU Wiki 'President Loki': "President Loki Laufeyson is a Variant of [[Loki]] who commanded an [[Loki Bandits|army of Loki Variants]] in the [[Void (End of Time)|Void]]." Marvel DB: "[[Loki Laufeyson (President) (Earth-TRN872)|President Loki]]" (TRN872 = "Reality of those Pruned by TVA and sent to the Void").
